name: landing-04-munchly
prompt: Show another screen of this same landing page further down. Keep the identical thin top navigation bar (the S logo and "Smart-Clearance", the links, "Sign in" and the green "Book a demo" button) and the same visual system and fonts. Replace everything below the navigation with the customer story below; no diorama, town or carton anywhere on this screen. Below the navigation, on the plain pale sage-white ground: 1) Top left, a small row: an orange rounded-square logo with a white letter m, then "Munchly Foods · snacks and drinks, Pune". 2) Left half: a large heading in the heavy dark display type, "One plan approved. Not one carton destroyed."; under it a quote in large regular dark text, "I approved one plan with the money on screen. The agents did the running around."; under the quote a small round photographic portrait of a smiling Indian woman in her thirties with long dark hair, beside "Priya Deshmukh" in bold and "Regional Supply-Chain Manager, Munchly Foods" in grey; then two buttons, green "Watch Munchly's batch, stage by stage" and white "Visit munchly.smartclearance.com". 3) Right half: a tall white card with a thin hairline edge and soft shadow, like a delivery tracker: "MF-2409-117" in small grey monospace, "Munchly Masala Chips 150 g · Rakesh Traders, Nagpur"; a row of nine small green filled dots joined by a line; the big green numeral "₹21,152" with the caption "recovered"; then four rows with values on the right in dark text: "If destroyed · −₹26,330" (only this number in red), "GST credit kept · ₹1,224", "Kiranas restocked · 31", "Cartons destroyed · 0". 4) Along the bottom, a row of four small white cards, each with a tiny round portrait: "Rakesh bhai · distributor, Nagpur · ended whole", "Ganesh ji · kirana, Itwari · 2 free with every 10", "Anita Rao · finance · credit note drafted", "Vikram Sethi · sustainability · BRSR line ready". Crisp flat interface with small photographic portraits; all text legible. Post-processing: the five round portraits (Priya Deshmukh, Rakesh bhai, Ganesh ji, Anita Rao, Vikram Sethi) were replaced by compositing the repo portraits design3/system/img/people/p-*.webp over the generated image (original kept as landing-04-munchly-generated.png), because the model drew the same face in every circle.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/

Not one carton destroyed.', a quote from Priya Deshmukh with her portrait, a tracker card for batch MF-2409-117 showing ₹21,152 recovered, and four small cards for Rakesh bhai, Ganesh ji, Anita Rao and Vikram Sethi.
